<title level="1" right="Creature Family">[Dragon, Diabolic](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=398)</title>

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 112

[Hell](/Planes.aspx?ID=42), according to some theologians, is a living entity in and of itself. Diabolic dragons, these scholars argue, are just extensions of the plane, living creatures that break off from Hell to enact its will. Whether this is true or whether diabolical dragons are simply the reborn souls of dragons sent to Hell, the fact remains that these dragons are powerful, cunning, and tyrannical. Every diabolic dragon's goal is to further Hell's will, though how this happens can vary. Regardless of their goals, these dragons always approach newcomers with an unsettling calmness.

<title level="2">Members</title>
[Adult Diabolic Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2939) (Creature 15), [Ancient Diabolic Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2940) (Creature 20), [Young Diabolic Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2938) (Creature 11)

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar_4_RelatedCreatures.png">Azhadar</title>

Azhadar, the great diabolic archdragon, serves the archdevil Moloch, the General of Hell. The dragon has great latitude to freely march Hell's armies where needed, but in recent centuries, she's found delight in leaving Hell to tempt great mortal warriors with countless promises. Those who give in find themselves conscripted into the armies of Hell when they inevitably meet their demise at the hands of a similarly empowered rival on the battlefield. Azhadar's most recent appearance was near Bloodcove, where she made an offer to a tyrannical pirate captain.
</aside>

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar_3_Locations.png">Diabolic Dragon Lairs</title>

A diabolical dragon's lair is a surprisingly sparse place. Most of these dragons find caverns or large rooms within Hell to claim as their lair but keep relatively little within. A diabolical dragon's hoard is generally made up of soul gems—magical gems designed to contain mortal souls— and infernal contracts. The contracts are ones still in effect that will resolve once the mortal signer's soul reaches Hell and is forcibly placed in a soul gem. While diabolical dragons pass the souls contained in these gems off to other parts of Hell to be used for countless purposes, most dragons hold on to the souls of mortals they find particularly intriguing and call upon the souls to be servants or for other wicked purposes at a later time.
</aside>

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="">Diabolic Dragon Spellcasters</title>

Diabolic dragon spellcasters tend to cast the following spells. 

### Young Diabolic Dragon
 **Divine Prepared Spells** DC 30, attack +24; **4th** [_dispelling globe_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1494), [_divine wrath_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1499), [_planar tether_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1636); **3rd** [_blindness_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1453), [_chilling darkness_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1464), [_harm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1552); **2nd** [_blood vendetta_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1454), [_darkness_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1480), [_translate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1723); **1st** [_command_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1470) (×2), [_fear_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1524); **Cantrips (4th)** [_detect magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1485), [_divine lance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1498), [_message_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1598), [_sigil_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1673), [_void warp_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1745) 

### Adult Diabolic Dragon
 **Divine Prepared Spells** DC 36, attack +30; As young diabolic dragon, plus **6th** [_banishment_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1448), [_blessed boundary_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1452), [_dominate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1501); **5th** [_sending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1665), [_translocate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1724), [_truespeech_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1728); **Cantrips (6th)** _detect magic_, _divine lance_, _message_, _sigil_, _void warp_ 

### Ancient Diabolic Dragon
 **Divine Prepared Spells** DC 42, attack +38; As adult diabolic dragon, plus **9th** _harm_, [_massacre_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1596), [_wails of the damned_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1747); **8th** [_canticle of everlasting grief_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1459), [_execute_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1519), [_pinpoint_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1633); **7th** [_eclipse burst_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1508), [_planar seal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1635), [_truespeech_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1728); **Cantrips (9th)** _detect magic_, _divine lance_, _message_, _sigil_, _void warp_
</aside>

<title level="2" right="Creature Family Group">Dragon</title>

**Related Families**
[Dragon, Adamantine](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=396), [Dragon, Conspirator](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=397), [Dragon, Empyreal](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=399), [Dragon, Fortune](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=400), [Dragon, Horned](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=401), [Dragon, Mirage](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=402), [Dragon, Omen](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=403)
